evidence.excerpt: FEDICS developed federated learning protocols enabling anomaly detection models trained at geographically distributed ICS sites to be aggregated without exchanging raw network traffic. The project addressed privacy constraints common in critical infrastructure contexts and evaluated ensemble aggregation strategies for combining site-level one-class classifiers. Pilot deployments were conducted at two water utility control centres and two district heating substations across the Hungarian–Serbian border region. The project also produced a joint curriculum module on ICS cybersecurity delivered at partner universities. Key deliverables included open-source federated aggregation software, two datasets, and six joint publications by the consortium.
